A man, driven by his own pride, arranges his daughter's marriage to prevent her from marrying the man who truly loves her. Starring Manoj Kumar, Sharmila Tagore, Mumtaz Askari.

When Raja and Asha get married, they realize that Raja's income is not sufficient for them and their two children. Asha then decides to get a job while Raja stays at home to look after the children. Starring Sanjeev Kumar, Moushumi Chatterjee, Arun Govil.

Ishaan, a student who has dyslexia, cannot seem to get anything right at his boarding school. Soon, a new unconventional art teacher, Ram Shankar Nikumbh, helps him discover his hidden potential. Starring Darsheel Safary, Aamir Khan, Tanay Chheda.
A man begins to despise his father when an uncle suggests that his father's new best friend may be an illegitimate son. Starring Ajay Devgan, Raveena Tandon, Amrish Puri.
A crime reporter helps police catch criminals. Starring Ashok Kumar, Jeetender, Moushumi Chatterjee.

Madhavi is an orphan living under the roof of her uncle, but when he arranges a marriage for her, she flees to the man she truly loves. Madhavi assumes Poonam's identity, vowing to raise her child. Starring Prem Chopra, Nasir Hussain, Asha Parekh.
A couple's (Sushmita Sen, J.D. Chakravarthi) young son (Ahsaas Channa) may have uncovered a malevolent, ghostly presence in their new home. Starring Sushmita Sen, J.D. Chakravarthi, Ahsaas Channa.

Jaggu gets arrested after a witness informs the police about his crimes. Raja is hired in his place. Once out, Jaggu kills the witness, who happens to be Raja's father. Starring Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Pooja Bhatt.

A small-town cook moves to London to earn a living, but from his employer's sudden death to the immigration officials on his trail, plans soon go sour. Starring Madhavan, Samita Bangargi, Asmita Sharma.
Left with amnesia after a car accident, a man (Arjun Rampal) believes his wife (Priyanka Chopra) is having an affair. Starring Arjun Rampal, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Kim Sharma.

A rich businessman disapproves of his son's passion for singing. This leads to friction between them and causes the boy to leave home. He adopts a new identity when he becomes a popular singer. Starring Rajesh Khanna, Simple Kapadia, Ashok Kumar.
